title: Canadian AI Policy Essentials
summary: You will be able to explain how AI is governed in Canada today: the federal and provincial laws and directives that apply, the bills that stalled, the institutions and funding behind Canada's AI ecosystem, and how Canada works with other countries on AI governance.
note: Modules 0 to 4 keep their exact titles and concepts, because Sofia's copy of the course already uses them. Modules 5 to 11 are new.

modules.title: Mapping the AI Landscape
modules.objective: Identify the key AI technologies, sectors, and societal impacts that define Canada’s AI environment.

modules.title: Canada’s Policy Foundations
modules.objective: Explain the principal federal and provincial policies that currently guide AI development and use in Canada.

modules.title: Regulatory Tools and Governance
modules.objective: Explore the regulatory mechanisms Canada employs to ensure accountable and trustworthy AI.

modules.title: Engaging Stakeholders
modules.objective: Recognize how government, industry, academia, and the public collaborate to shape AI policy.

modules.title: Future Directions & Global Alignment
modules.objective: Anticipate emerging policy trends and Canada’s role in international AI governance frameworks.

modules.title: The Artificial Intelligence and Data Act
modules.objective: Explain what AIDA (Part 3 of Bill C-27) proposed, how it would have worked, and what happened to it.

modules.title: Privacy Law Meets AI
modules.objective: Apply Canada's federal and provincial privacy law to AI systems that collect and use personal information.

modules.title: AI in the Federal Public Service
modules.objective: Describe the rules that govern how federal institutions build, buy and use AI.

modules.title: Voluntary Codes and AI Safety
modules.objective: Explain Canada's non-binding commitments for advanced AI and the institutions that study AI safety.

modules.title: Provinces and Sector Regulators
modules.objective: Identify how provinces and sector regulators shape AI use even without a federal AI law.

modules.title: Funding, Compute and the AI Economy
modules.objective: Describe how Canada funds AI research, talent and compute, and who runs that work.

modules.title: Canada in Global AI Governance
modules.objective: Explain the international agreements and forums Canada takes part in, and how they connect to domestic policy.
